# 10-portable-brain-cattle-runtimes.png — prompt

Style (shared series system): landscape 16:9 (1672x941). Warm off-white paper background, charcoal typography and outlines. Accents only from: cobalt blue, vermilion, teal, mustard. Crisp geometric editorial illustration, subtle depth, generous negative space. Minimal LARGE text labels exactly as quoted; icons carry secondary meaning. Causal arrows and containment boundaries. Avoid: dashboards, ornamental circuitry, photorealism, tiny labels, decorative AI glow.

Composition: center, a compact vault-like repository icon labeled "GIT-BACKED KNOWLEDGE BASE — THE PORTABLE BRAIN" in cobalt: a tidy stack of plain document sheets with a small branching-commit glyph, NOT a biological brain and NOT a database cylinder. Around it in a triangle, three clearly different runtime boxes, each rendered slightly translucent/disposable with a small recycle mark: "FLY MACHINE" (stamp icon), "SPRITE" (sleep/wake crescent), "SESSION SANDBOX" (expiring snapshot ring). Each runtime connects to the center with paired arrows labeled "CLONE / PULL" (inbound to runtime, teal) and "COMMIT / PUSH" (outbound to brain, vermilion). The center is the only opaque, permanent-looking object. Bottom caption: "WHEN THE BRAIN IS PORTABLE, EVERY COMPUTER CAN BE CATTLE".
